name: liminis-editor-external-consumer
description: CI proxy for a real external adopter of @liminis/editor: installs the packed tarball and type-checks and builds against its declarations.
//typescript: Pinned to 6.x on purpose, and not to be tidied up to 7. The package itself builds on TypeScript 7 (ADR-209), but consumers may not be there yet, and this is the check that the TS 7-emitted .d.ts still type-check for one that is not: verify:package installs the packed tarball here with --ignore-workspace and runs this tsc against it. Dependabot does not look in this directory.
